name: PRO COACH
description: Customizable coaching platform to manage clients, build training plans, track progress and run a PT business "without another monthly software subscription" (company-stated). Sold by Harrison Wallace, a "Certified Notion Creator" (homepage), so this looks like a Notion-based system rather than custom software (my read of the homepage). Pricing: $129 one-time, lifetime access (founder-stated). Homepage: "Trusted by 1,500+ coaches"; ~1,500 estimated users (founder-stated). Founded Nov 2024, UK. MRR shows $0 because it's all one-time sales. Image is the page's og:image (WebP, converted to PNG).

whyItPrints: It's positioned against Trainerize/TrueCoach subscriptions: "pay once, own it". It's a template business for a trade with tight margins. But it's sliding off a January peak.
